text:
Samira Khan: Quick update: were clarifying the PTO + emergency family leave overlap in the handbook. Effective 2026-06-01: employees can elect to run PTO concurrently with Emergency Family Leave for up to 10 days per event. Full update: https://intranet.redwood.com/policies/pto-emergency-leave

Ethan Brooks: Nice. Does this change pay treatment for short leaves?

Samira Khan: No change to base pay. It just lets you use PTO without extending unpaid leave. If you need additional unpaid leave beyond the emergency window, standard FMLA/local rules apply.

Samir (Legal): Addendum: local statutory leaves supersede this where required. Please include country in requests so Payroll can handle compliance.

Payroll Team: Filing note: choose expense code PTO-EFL when logging through People Ops form. Managers must approve.
